v.n: Yearbook Awards With The Abbott Elementary Cast

eps.o: The teachers prepare for the upcoming school year with new faces and big changes on the horizon.
Melissa tries to outsmart her students; Tariq causes chaos in Janine's class; a new guidance counselor joins the school.
The Abbott crew heads to the ballpark for Teachers' Appreciation Night at the Philadelphia Phillies game.
Gregory steps in to host game night at his apartment. Mr. Johnson, Ava, Barbara and Melissa head to the DMV to renew their licenses.
Barbara organizes a Halloween camping trip for older kids.
Abbott Elementary participates in the district’s "No Phones Day" initiative.
A new member joins Gregory's Garden Goofballs, and Janine pitches a new club idea to Ava.
Jacob takes the lead on organizing Abbott's annual winter show, and Janine celebrates her 30th birthday.
Abbott Elementary returns from winter break at their new temporary school: an abandoned mall. The teachers deal with unique challenges that come with teaching in the new location.
Growing pains hit Abbott Elementary as the PTA pressures Janine and Gregory for answers. Meanwhile, Jacob and Barbara become suspicious of Mr. Morton.
After the faculty finds surprising success operating the school in the mall, they quickly realize they are being taken advantage of. Meanwhile, a new custodian arrives to join Mr. Johnson.
When picture day catches the teachers at Abbott by surprise, chaos ensues.
It's Valentine's Day at Abbott, and the teachers find themselves meddling in students' love lives while navigating their own.
Janine asks Ava for a classroom aide, and the school seeks out a new gym teacher. Meanwhile, Dominic confides in Jacob.
An antidrug campaign visits the school, and Jacob is outraged by an unfair district election.
Jacob and Ava team up for an initiative. Meanwhile, Melissa and Janine help Mr. Johnson get ready for the Janitor's Ball.
Ava implements a no-homework policy at Abbott, sparking debate amongst the teachers.
It’s April Fools' Day, and while the Abbott teachers suffer pranks, Gregory makes a plan to make it through the day.
Janine and Gregory plan a vacation. Meanwhile, one of Melissa's most successful former students comes back for a visit.
Janine and Gregory have a night out. Meanwhile, Melissa, Barbara and Mr. Johnson have a movie night.
It's Ava Fest, and Ava's determined to make it her biggest yet.
Rumors begin to swirl when the Abbott crew is in Miami for PECSA weekend.
